welcome.title: Welcome to Side View .1107
welcome.description:
This is the home of **Side View**: one full-screen wall with up to six live screens you arrange however you want. Your game in the middle, two more across the top, the scoreboard along the bottom.

This server is where we build the culture around the tool: share setups, trade tips, shape what gets built next, and watch together.

fields.name: Start here
fields.value:
1. Read #rules (it's short).
2. Post your setup in #setups.
3. Ideas go to #feature-requests, problems to #bug-reports.

fields.name: Watch together
fields.value: Everyone watches on their own legal source in their own Side View. Talk in #game-night-chat or hop into **Watch Party** voice.

fields.name: Cast your setup
fields.value: Want to show off your wall or a new trick? Join **Side View Live** and ask a mod to bring you up. The pinned guide in #tips-and-shortcuts walks you through it.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Side View is a viewer. What you put on it is on you, and what you share here is on all of us. Keep it legal and keep it good.

fields.name: 1. Legal sources only
fields.value: Official, licensed or free-and-legal streams only. No links to unlicensed stream sites, anywhere on the server. AutoMod blocks the known ones.

fields.name: 2. Never rebroadcast what isn't yours
fields.value: Don't screen-share games, shows or movies to the server. Casting is for your setup, the app and your own content. Watch parties mean everyone watches on their own screen.

fields.name: 3. Respect each other
fields.value: No harassment, hate, or spam. Disagree about the game, not about each other.

fields.name: 4. Keep channels on topic
fields.value: Setups in #setups, ideas in #feature-requests, bugs in #bug-reports.

fields.name: 5. No personal info
fields.value: No logins, passwords, addresses or anyone else's private details. Side View will never ask for your passwords here.

fields.name: 6. Private means private
fields.value: This server is invite-only. Don't share invites without a mod's OK.

rules.footer: Breaking rule 1 or 2 is a ban. Everything else gets a warning first.

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.description: Where Side View is headed. Vote on ideas in #feature-requests and the top ones move up.

fields.name: Shipped
fields.value: Full-screen wall on any monitor · Side / Center / Grid presets · Per-screen lock · Picture-in-picture · Crossed-bones favorites · Control panel (Ctrl+Alt+P) · Share and import layout codes

fields.name: Next
fields.value: Layout presets you can name and save · Click a screen to make it the main one · Smarter video fill

fields.name: Later
fields.value: Sync favorites between PCs · Synced watch-party timers · An installer and auto-updates

tips.title: How to cast your setup
tips.description: Casting is for showing your Side View wall: layouts, tricks, new features. Never cast a game, show or movie you don't own the rights to.

fields.name: 1. Get your wall ready
fields.value: Load only content you're allowed to show (your own, or an official free stream that allows it). Or use empty screens: layouts look great on their own.

fields.name: 2. Join Side View Live
fields.value: Open the **Side View Live** stage and tap *Request to Speak*. A mod brings you up.

fields.name: 3. Share the window
fields.value: Click **Share Your Screen**, pick the **Side View** window, and go.

fields.name: 4. Share the layout
fields.value: Control panel (Ctrl+Alt+P) > Community > **Share my layout** copies a code. Paste it in #setups so others can try it with **Paste a layout**.

tips.title: Shortcuts
tips.description: `Ctrl+Alt+P` control panel · `Ctrl+Alt+S` show/hide · `Ctrl+Alt+F` settings bar · `Ctrl+Alt+D` next monitor · `Ctrl+Alt+T` cover the taskbar · `Ctrl+Alt+B` bars around screens · `Ctrl+Alt+N` add a screen · `Ctrl+Alt+M` mute all · `Ctrl+Alt+1/2/3` windows

sources.title: Legal sources
sources.description: Free and legal places to fill your screens. Post more here: official sources only.

fields.name: Sports
fields.value: Leagues' and teams' official YouTube channels (highlights, press conferences, some full games) · Free games on official league apps and networks when they offer them · Services you already pay for, signed in on your own screens

fields.name: News
fields.value: Official live news channels on YouTube (most networks run free 24/7 streams)

fields.name: Everything else
fields.value: NASA TV · Official music and esports channels on YouTube and Twitch · Your own streams and recordings

sources.footer: Not sure if a source is legal? If it isn't run by whoever owns the content, it doesn't go here.
